name: app-hider
title: App Hider
description: Hide selected Mac apps from normal app listings and restore them later.
author: leonidalekseev

commands.name: manage-apps
commands.title: Manage Hidden Apps
commands.subtitle: Hide and restore applications
commands.description: Move selected apps into a hidden, Spotlight-excluded folder and restore them later.

preferences.name: resetLaunchpad
preferences.title: Launchpad
preferences.label: Refresh Launchpad after hiding or restoring
preferences.description: macOS 15 and older: resets Launchpad and restarts the Dock (Launchpad folders and icon order are reset). macOS 26 and newer: restarts Spotlight, which hosts the Apps view.
